titles.title: Backstage
titles.plot: Teenage Lucie (Isild Le Besco) is a great fan of rock diva Lauren Waks (Emmanuelle Seigner), so she is thrilled when her mother arranges for the woman to pay a visit to their home. Lauren warbles a love song and leaves, and Lucie runs away to be with the object of her obsession. The teen manages to worm her way into Lauren's entourage and forms an emotionally co-dependent bond with the megastar.

titles.title: A Burning Hot Summer
titles.plot: Paul (Jérôme Robart) reflects on the summer he met Angèle (Monica Bellucci) and Frédéric (Louis Garrel) as he watches his friend being laid to rest.

titles.title: After Love
titles.plot: Marie and Boris decide to get a divorce after 15 years of marriage. Tensions rise when cash-strapped Boris must continue to live with Marie and the two children while trying to figure out how to divide the assets.

titles.title: As I Am
titles.plot: Set in the rolling hills of the English countryside, Philophobia is a picture of small town adolescence. One week of school remains for Kai, an aspiring writer, and his friends. How they choose to spend this time will cost one of them their life and leave them all changed forever.

titles.title: Blue Miracle
titles.plot: To save their cash-strapped orphanage, a guardian and his kids partner with a washed-up boat captain for a chance to win a lucrative fishing competition.

titles.title: Bombay Talkies
titles.plot: An anthology that includes four stories, by four different directors, which describes how Bollywood has an influence on the lives of different people.

titles.title: The Keys to the House
titles.plot: When his wife dies during childbirth, repairman Gianni (Kim Rossi Stuart) can't accept the responsibility of his newborn son and gives him up. Fifteen years later, he meets his son, Paolo (Andrea Rossi), for the first time on a train to Berlin, and discovers that he's disabled. The meeting is awkward, and Gianni is stunned by the treatment Paolo receives from his German doctors. Eventually, with the help of another parent (Charlotte Rampling), Gianni learns to cope with delayed fatherhood.

titles.title: DAU. Natasha
titles.plot: A lonely canteen worker at a secret Soviet research institute has a one-night-stand with a visiting French scientist and falls prey to the suspicions of an unforgiving KGB interrogator.

titles.title: Declaration of War
titles.plot: The idyllic life of a French couple (Valérie Donzelli, Jérémie Elkaïm) shatters when they learn that their young son has a brain tumor.

titles.title: Disco
titles.plot: Mirjam's family questions faith when she starts to lose at a faith-based dance competition.

titles.title: A Girl at My Door
titles.plot: A young police officer is sent to work in a small village and takes in a teenager to protect her from her abusive stepfather.

titles.title: Electrick Children
titles.plot: A Mormon youth (Liam Aiken) is accused of raping and impregnating his sister (Julia Garner), even though she insists that a voice she heard on a cassette tape actually did the deed.

titles.title: Et plus si affinités
titles.plot: Sophia, who has been married for a long time with Xavier, invites their young upstairs neighbors to dinner. As the ice is broken, the evening unfolds with a cascade of revelations, laying bare the intricacies of relationships.

titles.title: Gentle
titles.plot: Edina, a female bodybuilder is ready to sacrifice everything for the dream she shares with her life partner and trainer Adam: to win the world championship. The odd love she finds on her way makes her see the difference between her dreams and her true self.

titles.title: Giraffe
titles.plot: As a tunnel begins being built to connect Denmark and Germany, the present is set in motion toward the future.

titles.title: Girlfriend
titles.plot: A young man with Down syndrome romances a single mother who is mixed up with a violent ex.

titles.title: Girlhood
titles.plot: Marieme joins an all-girl gang in the projects of Paris and is slowly turned out of her shell by her three sassy neighbors. As she falls further under their bravado and volatile energy, she begins making brave and foolish choices.

titles.title: Gritt
titles.plot: Gry-Jeanette left Norway with the dream of becoming an actress. 17 rambling years later, having failed to find either fame in Hollywood or notoriety in Berlin, she’s back, as Gritt. Whilst her old friends from college have established successful careers on the Oslo theater circuit, Gritt is passionate about manifesting a radical collective ritual. But nobody seems to care. When she receives yet another funding rejection, and is thrown out of her apartment, Gritt’s situation becomes increasingly desperate. However, Gritt manages to get an internship at an underground theater company and secretly moves into their performance space. With the company away on tour, Gritt embarks on her mission to bury capitalism and the patriarchy.

titles.title: Outside Satan
titles.plot: A drifter commits murder to protect a young woman from her tormentors.

titles.title: Stray Dogs
titles.plot: An alcoholic man and his two children barely survive on the streets of Taipei until they cross paths with a lonely grocery clerk.

titles.title: Judith
titles.plot: An Israeli fighter (Peter Finch) sends a Jewish woman (Sophia Loren) to seduce a British major (Jack Hawkins) who knows where to find her Nazi ex-husband.

titles.title: Just a Gigolo
titles.plot: A Prussian veteran (David Bowie) spurns his decadent sweetheart (Sydne Rome) and joins a gigolo ring in post-World War I Berlin.

titles.title: Ennui
titles.plot: Martin (Charles Berling) is a middle-aged philosophy teacher in the midst of a crisis. Lacking direction or purpose in his life, he initiates an affair with Cécilia (Sophie Guillemin), a young artist's model who might have killed her former lover with the intensity of her sexual appetite. They share a purely erotic relationship as an intellectual abyss separates them. Before long, Martin needs to possess Cécilia and cannot resist a sharp descent into violent jealousy.

titles.title: Last Night in Rozzie
titles.plot: A tale of self-reflection and the importance of facing trauma, LAST NIGHT IN ROZZIE is a testament to the importance of confronting your past. Ronnie Russo (Neil Brown Jr, STRAIGHT OUTTA COMPTON), a successful lawyer in New York, is summoned back to his old Boston neighborhood, Roslindale, by his childhood best friend Joey Donovan (Jeremy Sisto, SIX FEET UNDER). Now on his deathbed, Joey has only one request for Ronnie--help him reunite with his 10-year-old son. Sympathetic to Joey's situation, Ronnie works to get closer to Joey's estranged ex-wife Pattie (Nicky Whelan, KNIGHT OF CUPS) to fulfill his friend's dying wish. However, the more he learns about the man that Joey has become, the more he questions his mission. Returning to his hometown after 25 years, Ronnie is forced to reconcile his traumatic past rooted in the last night he and Joey spent together as kids, and the repercussions that followed.

titles.title: Late August, Early September
titles.plot: Adrien (François Cluzet), a writer who has had only marginal commercial success, discovers that he is dying and tells his friend Gabriel (Mathieu Amalric), with whom he has had a tumultuous relationship. Gabriel tries to attend to his friend while making sense of his complicated romantic life, torn between dependable Jenny (Jeanne Balibar) and volatile Anne (Virginie Ledoyen). Meanwhile, other friends of Adrien struggle to assess their lives and careers in the wake of his revelation.

titles.title: La Petite Jérusalem
titles.plot: Laura (Fanny Valette), a young philosophy student, lives with her immigrant family in a Jewish enclave in Paris, and is beginning to question the strict dictates of her religion. She feels bad for her sister Mathilde (Elsa Zylberstein), who is married to a philanderer and believes Judaism compels her to stay with him. When Laura meets an attractive Muslim named Djamel (Hedi Tillette de Clermont-Tonnerre), her sexual desire erodes her commitment to her faith even more.

images.caption: A scene from the film "La Petite Jérusalem."
A scene from the film "La Petite Jérusalem."

titles.title: Little Pink House
titles.plot: A Connecticut nurse finds herself at the center of a political firestorm and a Supreme Court case centering on eminent domain.

titles.title: Los perros
titles.plot: Mariana, a member of the Chilean upper class, is despised by her family. When she has an affair with Juan, her riding teacher who is a former colonel, their dalliance cracks through the invisible walls that protect her family from the past.

titles.title: Love and Honor
titles.plot: During the Vietnam War, two soldiers (Liam Hemsworth, Austin Stowell) must make some life-changing decisions as they spend a week on a secret trip back to the U.S. learning the truth about love, honor and commitment.

titles.title: A Man Called Adam
titles.plot: A tormented jazz trumpeter (Sammy Davis Jr.) makes a downbeat comeback with a civil-rights activist and her grandfather (Louis Armstrong).

titles.title: Matching Jack
titles.plot: A married woman's life turns upside down after she meets an Irish sailor.

titles.title: Metalhead
titles.plot: A grief-stricken young woman adopts the persona of her deceased brother.

titles.title: Nenette and Boni
titles.plot: Boni (Grégoire Colin) spends his days making pizza and salivating over the local baker's gorgeous wife (Valeria Bruni-Tedeschi). But everything changes when he gets an unexpected visit from his teenage sister, Nenette (Alice Houri). Known for making trouble, the girl has run away from her boarding school. She wants to stay with Boni, and he eventually agrees. As the estranged pair reconnect, Boni gets some news that puts his life in perspective: his little sister is pregnant.

titles.title: Patrick
titles.plot: A young man on the cusp of adulthood returns home 10 years after being abducted.

titles.title: Prayers for the Stolen
titles.plot: Three young girls on the path to adolescence examine life in a town at war.

titles.title: Regular Lovers
titles.plot: Amidst the chaos of student and union protests, 20-year-old Parisian poet François (Louis Garrel) finds himself in legal hot water for dodging a stint in the French military. While at a party, he falls in love with Lilie (Clotilde Hesme), a would-be sculptor. When the riots begin to increase, the two seek refuge in the mansion of their affluent friend, Antoine (Julien Lucas), where, along with other French youths, they smoke opium, write poetry and reflect on the situation outside.

titles.title: Rhymes for Young Ghouls
titles.plot: In 1976, a Mi'kmaq teenager plots revenge against the sadistic Indian agent who imprisoned her in a residential school where rape and abuse are common.

titles.title: Second Coming
titles.plot: An unexplained pregnancy forces a husband to doubt his wife's faithfulness.

titles.title: Secret Things
titles.plot: When Sandrine (Sabrina Seyvecou), a bartender at a strip club, loses her job for refusing to have sex with a customer, she moves in with stripper Nathalie (Coralie Revel), who teaches her how to use her sexuality to win over men. Together, the two find work at a bank, determined to sleep their way to the top. While Sandrine destroys the life of middle-aged executive Delacroix (Roger Mirmont), Nathalie is drawn to Christophe Bernay (Fabrice Deville), the depraved son of the firm's dying founder.

titles.title: Shelter
titles.plot: A homeless Nigerian immigrant (Anthony Mackie) and a junkie (Jennifer Connelly) band together for survival on the streets of New York.

titles.title: She's Lost Control
titles.plot: A sexual surrogate (Brooke Bloom) develops feelings for a new client (Marc Menchaca).

titles.title: Short Term 12
titles.plot: A supervisor (Brie Larson) at a group home for at-risk teens connects with a new resident (Kaitlyn Dever) while facing a personal crisis of her own.

titles.title: Silent Souls
titles.plot: A man and a companion go on a journey to cremate his beloved wife on a riverbank.

titles.title: Sun
titles.plot: A young man pretends to be the father of an unborn baby to help the mother sell it once it's born.

titles.title: Spaceship
titles.plot: A girl fakes her own alien abduction and disappears, leaving her father to search for her in a strange teenage world of unicorns and black holes.

titles.title: Spoken Word
titles.plot: A poet (Kuno Becker) falls prey to the lure of criminal life after he returns home to care for his dying father.

titles.title: The Stoning of Soraya M.
titles.plot: An Iranian woman (Shohreh Aghdashloo) tells a journalist (James Caviezel) about the unjust and brutal death of her innocent niece (Mozhan Marnò).

titles.title: Summer Hours
titles.plot: When elderly matriarch Hélène Berthier discovers that her health is declining, she contacts her three adult children about contending with her valuable art collection after her passing. As the family gathers, local son Frédéric is on hand, while his jet-setting siblings, Adrienne and Jérémie, fly in from abroad. Together, they try to agree on what to do with their mother's collection, as they also grapple with her mortality.

titles.title: The Dog Lover
titles.plot: An animal rights activist (Allison Paige) poses as a college intern to investigate possible abuse on a dog-breeding farm.

titles.title: The Dog Thief
titles.plot: Martín, a shoeshine boy who works in the streets of La Paz, Bolivia, decides to steal the dog of his best client, a lonely tailor he has begun to imagine as his father.

titles.title: The Last
titles.plot: A Jewish woman makes a stunning confession to her family.

titles.title: The Last Tree
titles.plot: After growing up in quiet, rural Lincolnshire, teenager Femi struggles with unfamiliar surroundings and cultural differences when he moves in with his mother in London.

titles.title: The Mistress
titles.plot: A scheming woman becomes a pawn in her own diabolical game when a string of mysterious incidents land her face to face with her current target's wife.

titles.title: The Witnesses
titles.plot: Adrien (Michel Blanc) is a middle-aged doctor who's still single and enjoys cruising younger men. One night he's sexually rebuffed by a boy named Manu (Johan Libéreau) but pursues a friendship with him anyway. He takes Manu along on a seaside vacation with his best friend, Sarah (Emmanuelle Béart), and her policeman husband, Mehdi (Sami Bouajila). Shortly thereafter, Manu and Mehdi begin an affair, causing significant tension within the two couples that worsen when Manu is diagnosed with AIDS.

titles.title: The Word
titles.plot: A man's life is destroyed when his son is kidnapped and murdered.

titles.title: Tyrannosaur
titles.plot: An angry, violent alcoholic (Peter Mullan) finds respite with a devout woman (Olivia Colman) whose husband abuses her.

titles.title: Village Rockstars
titles.plot: A 10-year-old girl living in poverty in a village in Assam, India, dreams of owning a guitar and forming a band with the local boys.

titles.title: Vision
titles.plot: A French woman traveling through the forests of Japan recalls the first romance of her life.

titles.title: Western
titles.plot: When some German construction workers begin a challenging new job in the Bulgarian countryside, their sense of adventure is awakened, but so, too, are their prejudices.

titles.title: When We Leave
titles.plot: A young Turkish woman fights for self-determination and independence from her family .
